name: KSU_martin
summary: KSU_martin is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles lot size after each losing trade while resetting to the initial lot after a win. It opens trades based on a simple signal condition and relies on the Martingale progression to recover losses, which inherently carries exponential risk on consecutive losses.
summary_zh: KSU_martin是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，在每次亏损后将手数翻倍，盈利后重置为初始手数。它基于简单信号条件开仓，并依赖马丁格尔倍投来回收亏损，这在连续亏损时具有指数级风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的马丁格尔仓位管理策略，核心概念是在亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，以此在赢利时覆盖之前的全部亏损并获得初始手数的利润。入场条件基于简单的信号判断，可能涉及指标交叉或价格突破等基础逻辑。出场条件通常为固定止盈或达到目标利润后平仓，部分实现可能不设止损或仅设置较宽的止损。仓位管理是策略的核心——初始手数开仓，亏损后手数按2倍递增（1→2→4→8→16...），盈利后回到初始手数。资金管理方面，该策略缺乏对最大连续亏损次数的限制，没有账户余额比例的风控机制，在连续亏损时可能迅速耗尽账户资金。整体来看，这是一个高风险策略，依赖市场最终回归有利方向的假设，但在强趋势行情中可能导致爆仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Martingale position sizing strategy, where the core concept is to double the lot size after each losing trade, so that a single win can recover all previous losses plus yield a profit equal to the initial lot size. Entry conditions are based on a simple signal logic, likely involving basic indicator crossovers or price action triggers. Exit conditions typically use a fixed take-profit target or close upon reaching a desired profit level; some implementations may lack stop-losses entirely or use very wide stops. Position sizing is the heart of the strategy — starting with an initial lot, doubling on each loss (1→2→4→8→16...), and resetting to the initial lot after a win. Money management is essentially absent as a protective mechanism: there is no cap on the maximum number of consecutive loss doublings, no equity-based risk limit, and the account can be blown rapidly during extended adverse moves. Overall, this is a high-risk strategy that assumes the market will eventually move favorably, but sustained trending conditions can lead to account liquidation.

pros: 理论上一笔盈利即可回收全部前期亏损并获利
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和实现
在震荡行情中可能表现良好，因为价格经常回归
pros_en: Theoretically, a single winning trade can recover all prior losses and produce a profit
Strategy logic is simple and straightforward, easy to understand and implement
May perform well in ranging markets where price frequently reverts
cons: 连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致爆仓
缺乏有效的资金管理和最大亏损步数限制
对账户净值要求极高，小账户无法承受多步马丁倍投
无止损或宽止损设计在极端行情中风险不可控
cons_en: Lot size grows exponentially during consecutive losses, potentially leading to margin call
Lacks effective money management and maximum loss-step cap
Requires extremely high account equity; small accounts cannot sustain multiple Martingale steps
No stop-loss or wide stop-loss design makes risk uncontrollable during extreme market moves
improvements: 添加最大马丁步数限制和账户净值百分比风控
增加止损设置和最大回撤保护机制，防止账户爆仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale step limit and equity percentage-based risk control
Implement stop-loss settings and maximum drawdown protection to prevent account blow-up

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍投在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致爆仓
无止损或无最大步数限制，风险无上限
对账户净值和保证金要求极高，小资金账户无法承受
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot growth on consecutive losses,极易leading to margin call
No stop-loss or maximum step limit means risk is unbounded
Extremely high equity and margin requirements; small accounts cannot withstand the progression
